I am a Chilean researcher based in Budapest, currently a **Postdoctoral Research Fellow** at the [Center for Collective Learning](https://centerforcollectivelearning.org/) (Corvinus University of Budapest).

My work combines social network analysis, applied microeconometrics, and experimental methods to study social integration, inequality, and learning contexts.

[Explore my research &rarr;](research/index.qmd){.about-links .subtitle}
